name: Mehao Temple
town_description: Roing is the headquarters of Lower Dibang Valley district in eastern Arunachal Pradesh, on the banks of the Dibang river. It is the gateway town for the Dibang Valley circuit, including Mehao Lake and the Mehao Wildlife Sanctuary about 17 km away.

travel.airport: Dibrugarh Airport (Assam), about 100-120 km; Tezu Airport (TEI) has limited scheduled flights.
travel.railway: Tinsukia Junction (Assam), about 90-100 km away, is the nearest major railhead.
travel.road: Unverified; if the intended site is Mehao Lake it is about 17 km from Roing, partly through the Mehao Wildlife Sanctuary.
